prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 23-year-old graduate with a short chestnut bob, freckles and round glasses has removed her academic cap and lifts it beside her shoulder, smiling with relieved pride. She wears a plain graduation gown in a quiet university courtyard after the ceremony. Keep her other hand relaxed, her whole cap visible, and the architecture softly behind her in gentle afternoon daylight. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Vertical 4:5 cover composition. Keep faces and important hands above the lower fifth; normal continuous clothing or furniture forms the quiet lower area. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional composition and anatomy requirements: Exact 4:5 vertical photograph. The square academic cap has believable rigid flat geometry, one tassel and no emblems; the graduate's visible fingers grip its lower edge naturally beside her shoulder. Her lowered opposite hand may rest by her side, without extra arms. No diploma or sign with writing.
review: Reviewed full portrait: a freckled graduate with chestnut bob and round glasses holds a complete square mortarboard beside her shoulder. Cap edge, tassel and gripping fingers look coherent; face and gown are natural, opposite hand rests by her side. Continuous gown forms most of the lower region; no readable writing. PNG 1122x1402, 4:5 within one pixel.
